patterns.database_migration_pattern: Alembic migrations in alembic/versions/ with naming: YYYYMMDD_NNNN_description.py
patterns.repository_pattern: SQLAlchemy repositories in src/file_organizer/api/repositories/ with static methods
patterns.service_pattern: Service classes in src/file_organizer/services/ with clear separation of concerns
patterns.test_pattern: pytest with fixtures in tests/conftest.py, organized by module structure

existing_implementations.description: Found existing database layer with SQLAlchemy ORM, file_metadata table with basic indexes, BM25 in-memory search, file scanning using rglob(), caching infrastructure with Redis, and comprehensive test suite
performance_bottlenecks: File scanning uses rglob() which loads all files into memory
BM25 index rebuilds in-memory on each search (not persisted)
Missing database indexes for common queries (name, mime_type, size_bytes)
File listing API loads all files before pagination
Deduplication hashes files individually without batching

file_scanning.current: Uses Path.rglob() which loads all paths into memory
file_scanning.target: Stream files using os.scandir() with chunked processing

database_queries.target: Add composite indexes for common query patterns

search_performance.current: BM25 index rebuilt in-memory on each search
search_performance.target: Persist BM25 index to disk, lazy load on startup

file_listing.current: Loads all files, sorts in memory, then paginates
file_listing.target: Stream files and use database pagination

memory_usage.current: Loads entire file lists into memory
memory_usage.target: Generator-based streaming with max 500MB memory footprint
